output_list.reason: The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function allows a user to transfer arbitrary large amounts of tokens to an arbitrary address, due to a typo in the function logic, where '_value + burnPerTransaction' is used instead of '_value' in the line 'balanceOf[_from] -= _value + burnPerTransaction;'. This can be exploited to overflow the balance of any user and allow attackers to steal their funds.
